title: Yesterday's Network Outage & Server Restarts: Past Simple
description: Log IT incident tickets, system reboots, and network outage resolutions using regular and irregular Past Simple verbs.
learning_objectives: Use regular Past Simple forms (-ed) for IT actions (rebooted, crashed, restored, pinged)
Master irregular past forms (lost, went, came, broke, ran) in incident logs
Formulate past questions and negations with 'did' and 'didn't'

questions.prompt: Yesterday at 22:15, the core datacenter switch _____ responding to network ping requests.

explanations.correct: Regular past tense with doubled consonant: 'stopped'.
explanations.wrong_D: Present perfect cannot be used with a specific completed past time ('yesterday at 22:15').

questions.cz_learning_point: In English, specific past time points ('yesterday at 22:15') strictly require Past Simple: 'stopped'.

questions.prompt: The systems engineer _____ the virtual database host after installing the kernel patch.
We _____ connection to the Microsoft Azure tenant during the fiber maintenance window.

explanations.wrong_C: 'loosed' is an incorrect form; 'loose' is an adjective meaning not tight.
explanations.wrong_D: Participle alone cannot act as predicate.

questions.cz_learning_point: The irregular past of 'lose' is 'lost' (ztratili jsme spojení). Do not confuse with 'loose' (volný).

questions.prompt: Why _____ the automated backup script fail to trigger at midnight?

explanations.correct: Past Simple questions with action verbs ('fail') require auxiliary 'did'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Past questions take 'did': 'Why did the backup fail...?', not *Why failed the backup?*.

questions.prompt: The security firewall _____ not block the VPN traffic after the rule update.

explanations.correct: Past Simple negation uses 'did not' + base form: 'did not block'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'firewall nezablokoval'. Past negative auxiliary is 'did not block', never *was not block*.

questions.prompt: The primary power supply unit _____ offline following an unexpected electrical surge.

explanations.wrong_C: 'gone' is the past participle, requiring auxiliary 'has/had'.

questions.cz_learning_point: The irregular past of 'go' is 'went': 'The unit went offline' (přešla do offline režimu).

questions.prompt: The IT support team _____ the corrupted Active Directory user profile in twenty minutes.

explanations.wrong_C: Participle alone cannot be the main verb.

questions.prompt: Network latency _____ significantly once the redundant fiber link was activated.

explanations.wrong_C: 'felled' means cut down (e.g. felled a tree).

questions.cz_learning_point: The irregular past tense of 'fall' is 'fell' (odezva klesla).

questions.prompt: _____ you receive the automated PagerDuty alert on your mobile device last night?

explanations.correct: Past Simple questions with a specific past time frame ('last night') use 'Did'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Have' requires past participle 'received' and cannot pair with 'last night'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Dostal jste upozornění včera v noci?'. Use 'Did you receive...?', not *Have you received last night?*.

questions.prompt: The cooling fans in rack B-04 _____ at maximum RPM throughout the overheating incident.

explanations.wrong_C: Participle alone cannot act as predicate.

questions.cz_learning_point: The irregular past of 'run' is 'ran': 'The fans ran at maximum RPM' (ventilátory běžely na maximum).
